## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all 10 functional requirements (FR-001 through FR-010) explicitly documented in the spec? [Completeness, Spec §FR]
- [x] CHK002 Are all 7 measurable success criteria (SC-001 through SC-007) documented and quantified? [Completeness, Spec §SC]
- [x] CHK003 Are user roles explicitly specified (developers and end customers per clarification Q1)? [Completeness, Clarification Q1]
- [x] CHK004 Are edge cases explicitly identified and documented (minimum 2 edge cases per spec Edge Cases section)? [Completeness, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK005 Are assumptions explicitly listed and validated against constitution principles? [Completeness, Spec §Assumptions]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK006 Are all success criteria technology-agnostic (no implementation details like FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Streamlit)? [Clarity, Spec §SC]
- [x] CHK007 Are all [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers resolved? None should remain in the spec. [Completeness, Clarification]
- [x] CHK008 Are all functional requirements phrased as testable "System MUST" statements without vague adjectives? [Clarity, Spec §FR]
- [x] CHK009 Is 'prominent display' or other qualitative terms quantified with specific sizing/positioning or measurable criteria? [Clarity, Spec §SC]
- [x] CHK010 Are 'health check', 'responds', 'starts without errors' and similar terms quantified with specific timing thresholds (e.g., "within 2 seconds")? [Clarity, SC-002, SC-003]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK011 Do user story acceptance scenarios in User Story 1 and User Story 2 remain consistent with each other and with the success criteria? [Consistency, Spec §User Stories]

- [x] CHK013 Do security assumptions (JWT centralization, Argon2id hashing, RBAC least-privilege) align across Assumptions section and Success Criteria? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, SC]
- [x] CHK014 Do layer separation requirements (Domain, Application, Infrastructure, Presentation) not overlap or contradict across Functional Requirements FR-007 and Module structure FR-008? [Consistency, Spec §FR FR-007, FR-008]
